title: The Parlor Shift Note
description: 📄 Forensic Report #104 inspecting a slip of parchment found under the sofa cushion.
question: Decrypt this message shifted by +2: 'VJG LCYGN KU KP VJG XCWNV'
answer: THE JEWEL IS IN THE VAULT
hints: Each letter has been shifted forward by 2 positions in the alphabet.
To decrypt, move each letter backward by 2 steps.
V minus 2 is T, J minus 2 is H, G minus 2 is E. VJG becomes THE.
solution: Moving each letter backward by 2 steps (V->T, J->H, G->E) reveals: 'THE JEWEL IS IN THE VAULT'.
